registration.title: THE META-CORRELATION TEST (W057's discriminator; R80's reserved redundancy-profile card)
registration.registration: frozen at the birth commit BEFORE compute; no bar shopping
registration.background_verbatim: W057 (THINKING.md) — seven measured objects split into a STATE-CLOCK (read geometry, shared across names/slots) and a HISTORY-CLOCK (lineage-relative); the hypothesis: the history-clock IS the decorrelation structure (one measurable under every lineage-relative fact). W056 sharpened it; R81 added the alias caveats (menu is name-aliased; rows trajectory-clustered). The test: do the lineage-relative quantities CORRELATE with decorrelation measurements on the same states?
registration.design_verbatim: the four on-disk pairs, regressed side by side: (i) x24's receptivity panel lifts (the authorship-structured noise floor) vs elicitation consistency on the same states; (ii) x47's lift-termination pattern (the ZEPHYRA rungs' per-context response) vs the rungs' family structure; (iii) e341's arms' gm12 generalization vs their cross-geometry r — the FIRST FREE ANCHOR (x44's committed r matrix); (iv) wash-proofness vs consistency — the SECOND FREE ANCHOR (x43's stalled composed arms vs x45's walk). Pre-register the scorer per pair (what counts as 'shares a sign and a rough scale'); disclose power honestly (the trajectory-clustering caveat: the effective n is ~6 series, not 82 rows); no bar-shopping — the pooled verdict rule frozen at birth.

bars_verbatim.ONE-OBJECT: the regressions share a sign and a rough scale, anchored by the two free points — the history-clock IS the decorrelation structure; W057's hypothesis (a) lands; the meta-layer enters THE LAWS as a methods-grade claim.
bars_verbatim.SEPARATE-OBJECTS: the lineage-relative facts refuse to correlate with each other — the two-clocks pattern is a family of binaries, not one object; W057's wilder tail closes.
bars_verbatim.UNPOWERED: the honest gap — too few independent series to adjudicate (report the point estimates + the power analysis).

registration.lab_lean_verbatim: ONE-OBJECT, weakly (the two free anchors already point the same way: gm12-generalization and wash-proofness both sit on the decorrelated side; the co-movement find r=+0.667 binds two warm arms). COUNTER (grounds stated): SEPARATE-OBJECTS — the lineage-relative quantities have resisted unification all week (the fingerprint retracted; N1's menu is name-aliased; x47's lift channel refused to pool), and 6 dependent series may not power the regression at all.

P_x46a.guess: ONE-OBJECT, weakly (concurring with the lab lean)
P_x46a.grounds: (1) design-time disclosure: pairs (i)/(iii)/(iv) are arithmetic on committed literals, signs visible at design reconnaissance and pointing the lean's way; the genuinely open regression is pair (ii). (2) risks registered: (a) pair-(ii)-crack -> S1 fails -> UNPOWERED; (b) pair (ii) negative + a second pair <= -0.3 -> SEPARATE-OBJECTS; (c) pair (iii)'s rank near-tie is why Pearson is the frozen primary everywhere.
P_x46a.scored: TRUE iff the pooled verdict == ONE-OBJECT

frozen_rule.primary_statistic: Pearson r on the oriented (D, L) axes, every pair
frozen_rule.ONE-OBJECT: S1: all four r > 0 and |r| >= 0.2; S2: >= 3 of 4 r >= 0.5; S3: anchors (iii) and (iv) both r >= 0.5
frozen_rule.SEPARATE-OBJECTS: O1: >= 2 pairs r <= -0.3; or O2: >= 3 pairs |r| < 0.2
frozen_rule.riders: Spearman, sensitivities, p-values: disclosures only, never adjudicating
